leads.title: Ivory Coast Penal Code - Article 360
leads.documents: Criminal penalty for public same-sex sexual acts under public indecency provision; increased penalty for same-sex vs opposite-sex acts and doubled if minor involved.
leads.detail: Quoted in French in article with English translation: imprisonment 6 months to 2 years and fine 50,000 to 300,000 francs for indecent/contrary to nature act with same-sex individual

leads.title: Ivory Coast Penal Code - Articles 358 and 359
leads.documents: Unequal age of consent: 18 for homosexual couples vs 15 for heterosexual couples.
leads.detail: Cited in article section 'Laws regarding same-sex sexual activity' - no URL visible

leads.title: United Nations Human Rights Council Universal Periodic Review - March 2010
leads.documents: Ivorian government position on non-discrimination on grounds of sexual orientation and gender identity; refusal to start awareness-raising programs as not a current priority.
leads.detail: Representative of Ivory Coast statement at UPR, March 2010 - no URL visible

leads.title: National Human Rights Council of Côte d'Ivoire (CNDH) - September 2024 press release
leads.documents: State human-rights machinery calling on public to refrain from online hatred/violence toward woubis (gay men and trans women) and lelés (lesbians and trans men); affirms they benefit from human rights in Ivorian Constitution and international treaties.
leads.detail: September 2024 press release quoted: 'despite their different sexual orientation and contrary to our customs and traditions...' - no URL visible

leads.title: President Alassane Ouattara - 2024 pledge for anti-homosexuality bill
leads.documents: Government intent to introduce bill to Parliament to 'counter the expansion' of homosexuality; signals enforcement/policy shift.
leads.detail: 2024 presidential promise cited in 'Discrimination protections and government involvement' - no URL visible

leads.title: U.S. Department of State - 2023 Report on Human Rights Practices (Côte d'Ivoire)
leads.documents: Ongoing discrimination in healthcare, housing, employment; family evictions and school dropout; lack of secure housing for transgender people; employment firing; conversion therapy including transgender man suicide after forced prayer camp; religious leaders preaching against LGBTQ.
leads.detail: Cited as 'U.S. State Department's 2023 report' - no URL visible

leads.title: U.S. Department of State - 2011 Human Rights Report (Côte d'Ivoire)
leads.documents: Widespread societal stigmatization; government failure to counter it; beatings, imprisonment, verbal abuse, humiliation, extortion of gay men by police/gendarmes/armed forces; FRCI beating/abuse of gay men and transgender persons, mostly sex workers; complaints not filed for fear of reprisals; precarious post-electoral crisis situation.
leads.detail: Block-quoted in 'History' section re: Second Ivorian Civil War period 2010-2011 - no URL visible

leads.title: U.S. Department of State - Adoption eligibility guidance for Côte d'Ivoire
leads.documents: Legal status that gay and lesbian individuals and couples are not legally recognized as eligible to adopt.
leads.detail: Quoted: 'gay and lesbian individuals and couples are not legally recognized as eligible to adopt' - no URL visible

leads.title: Fondygender (Ivorian NGO) assessment
leads.documents: Police/rights machinery handling of anti-LGBTQ violence complaints; claims authorities improved in understanding/handling complaints as of 2023, vs reports of police not taking violence seriously and blaming victims.
leads.detail: Cited in 'Living conditions' re: reporting violence to police - no URL visible

leads.title: Gromo (LGBTQ group) - Abidjan violence tally 2024
leads.documents: Documented incidents: 45 assaults against LGBTQ people in Abidjan between early September and late October 2024 amid influencer calls for violence and misinformation.
leads.detail: Cited in 'Living conditions' - 45 incidents, early Sept to late Oct 2024 - no URL visible
